source_refs.note: Exercise 12.3, Question 3: limit of weekly sales S(t) = 500t/(t + 10) and its meaning (book p.236). Answer key PDF 310: 500.

blocks.prompt: 3 A company's weekly sales (in thousands) follow the function \(S(t) = \dfrac{500t}{t + 10}\). What is the limit of \(S(t)\) as \(t \to \infty\) and what does it represent?
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein do hisse hain: limit nikalna, aur phir batana ke yeh limit real life mein kya matlab rakhti hai.
\(t\) bara ho to upar \(500t\) bhi bara aur neeche \(t + 10\) bhi bara, yani \(\frac{\infty}{\infty}\) form. Is ka ilaaj: sab se bari power se divide karna.
Plan: upar neeche \(t\) se divide karein, \(\frac{10}{t} \to 0\) lagayein, phir matlab samjhayein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(S(t) = \dfrac{500t}{t + 10}\), sales hazaron (thousands) mein, har hafte.
Humein find karna hai: \(\lim_{t \to \infty} S(t)\) aur us ka matlab.
Tareeqa: Rational function (fraction) ki limit infinity par nikalni ho to har term ko denominator ki sab se bari power (yahan \(t\)) se divide karte hain, phir \(\frac{c}{t} \to 0\) istemal karte hain.

Upar neeche \(t\) se divide karein
\[S(t) = \frac{500t / t}{t/t + 10/t}\]
\[= \frac{500}{1 + \frac{10}{t}}\]
Kyun: Fraction ke upar aur neeche ko ek hi (non-zero) number se divide karne se value nahi badalti. Is se \(\frac{\infty}{\infty}\) wali uljhan khatam ho jati hai.
Dhyan dein: Har term ko divide karna hai; sirf \(t\) ko divide kar ke \(10\) ko waisa hi chhor dena ghalti hai.

Limit lein
\[\lim_{t \to \infty} \frac{10}{t} = 0\]
\[\lim_{t \to \infty} S(t) = \frac{500}{1 + 0} = 500\]
Kyun: 10 ko bohat bare \(t\) se divide karein to 0 ke qareeb aata hai, jaise \(t = 1000\) par \(\frac{10}{1000} = 0.01\). Baqi \(\frac{500}{1} = 500\) bachta hai. Shortcut yaad rakhein: jab upar aur neeche \(t\) ki power barabar ho, to limit leading coefficients ka ratio hoti hai, yahan \(\frac{500}{1}\).

Matlab samjhein
\[500 \text{ thousand} = 500{,}000\]
Kyun: \(S\) hazaron mein hai, is liye 500 ka matlab 500 hazaar, yani 500,000 units. Lambe arse mein haftawar sales is hadd ke qareeb pohanchti hain lekin us se aage nahi barhtin. Isay saturation level (market bhar jane ki hadd) kehte hain.

Tasdeeq
\[S(990) = \frac{495{,}000}{1000} = 495\]
Kyun: 990 hafte baad sales 495 hazaar hain: 500 ke qareeb, magar ab bhi us se kam. Limit ka matlab yahi hai. Shuru mein (\(t = 10\)) sales sirf 250 hazaar thin, yani shuru mein tezi se barhti hain aur baad mein rafta rafta hadd ki taraf sarakti hain.
blocks.final_answer: \(\lim_{t \to \infty} S(t) = 500\): lambe arse mein haftawar sales 500 hazaar (500,000) ki hadd ke qareeb pohanchti hain
